connector.name: Tooluniverse
connector.registryDescription: 2,500+ scientific tools for AI scientists: life science, research, literature, and more.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package tooluniverse. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the mims-harvard account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: ONCOKB_API_TOKEN
